title: Peer Showcase Feedback
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting peer showcase feedback to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Triage each showcase suggestion into accept, modify, reject, or not-loggable, and justify the decision against what the artifact means rather than who suggested it
Reject a plausible-sounding suggestion that would misrepresent the data, and record an auditable reason (the meaning guard)
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
